    Why Choose AIT – School of Architecture & Planning?

    Apeejay Institute of Technology – School of Architecture & Planning (AIT-SAP), Greater Noida, is committed to nurturing future architects through a perfect blend of academic excellence, practical learning, creativity, and professional ethics. With a learner-centric approach and state-of-the-art infrastructure, the Institute provides an environment where students can develop the knowledge, skills, and confidence required to excel in the field of architecture.

    What Makes Us Different?

    COA Approved & AKTU Affiliated
    B.Arch. and M.Arch. programmes are approved by the Council of Architecture (COA) and affiliated with Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow.

    Experienced & Dedicated Faculty
    Learn from highly qualified academicians and industry professionals with rich teaching, research, and professional experience.

    Modern Infrastructure
    Well-equipped design studios, computer laboratories, material museum, climatology lab, survey lab, workshops, library, seminar halls, and smart classrooms provide an excellent learning environment.

    Industry-Oriented Curriculum
    A curriculum that combines theoretical knowledge with practical exposure through live projects, design studios, workshops, site visits, and industry interactions.

    Research & Innovation
    Students are encouraged to participate in research projects, innovation activities, seminars, conferences, and publications to enhance their academic and professional capabilities.

    Professional Training & Placement Support
    Dedicated Training & Placement Cell offering internships, career guidance, portfolio development, soft skills training, and campus placement assistance.

    Hands-on Learning Experience
    Exposure to model making, surveying, construction workshops, architectural documentation, field studies, and practical design exercises.

    Technology-Driven Education
    Access to advanced architectural software, digital design tools, Building Information Modelling (BIM), CAD applications, and emerging technologies.

    Vibrant Student Life
    Active student clubs, cultural activities, technical events, sports, heritage programmes, photography, and environmental initiatives ensure holistic development.

    Excellent Library & Learning Resources
    A well-stocked library with books, journals, research publications, e-resources, and digital learning materials to support academic excellence.

    Safe & Comfortable Campus
    Separate hostel facilities for boys and girls, Wi-Fi-enabled campus, medical support, sports facilities, and a secure learning environment.

    Focus on Sustainability
    Strong emphasis on sustainable architecture, climate-responsive design, environmental planning, and responsible architectural practices.

    Strong Alumni & Industry Network
    Opportunities to interact with successful alumni and leading architects, helping students build valuable professional connections.

    Holistic Personality Development
    Workshops, leadership programmes, communication skills training, community engagement, and extracurricular activities prepare students for successful careers and responsible citizenship.
